display.purpose: Landing page hero headline only. Maximum authority.

headline.purpose: Section headings across landing and dashboard.

body.purpose: Primary content, alert explanations, descriptions. Cap at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Dashboard section headers, metadata keys, badge text, nav category labels. Always uppercase.

shadows.name: overlay-mask
shadows.purpose: Alert panel backdrop. Signals modal-level interruption.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Toast notifications. Top-layer temporary messaging only.

shadows.name: hero-depth
shadows.purpose: Browser mockup on landing page. Decorative, brand surface only.

shadows.name: threat-glow
shadows.purpose: Fraud event dots in event timeline. Semantic: marks a confirmed fraud event.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover/active state changes on interactive rows and nav items.

motion.name: entry-slide
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 22px to 0, duration 0.5s, easeOut
motion.purpose: Section entry animation on landing page. Not used on dashboard.

motion.name: entry-stagger
motion.purpose: Staggered entry for landing page feature grids and stat strips.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: Live monitoring indicator. Ambient confirmation the system is running.

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.purpose: Progress bar fill transition for risk scores and peer comparison bars.

motion.name: new-alert-slide
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY -8px to 0, duration 0.3s, ease-out
motion.purpose: New event sliding into the live feed from top.

breakpoints.name: max-content
breakpoints.purpose: Max-width container for landing page sections.

components.name: Button Primary
components.description: Primary CTA. Highest-contrast element on any dark surface. Used for 'View Live Demo', 'Get a Demo'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F0F6FC; color: #0D1117; padding: 12px 28px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8B949E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F0F6FC; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Button Ghost
components.description: Secondary action alongside a primary CTA. Equal padding, lower visual weight.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #F0F6FC; padding: 12px 28px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: 1px solid #30363D; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1C2128; border-color: #4D5562; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F0F6FC; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Button Danger
components.description: Destructive or high-commitment analyst action. 'MARK RESOLVED' in the alert panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #DC2626; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DC2626; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Risk Badge Critical
components.description: Signals critical/high risk. The most important component in the system - stops the eye before the analyst reads anything else.
components.css: .ds-risk-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border-radius: 2px; white-space: nowrap; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-risk-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-risk-score { opacity: 0.8; margin-left: 2px; } .ds-risk-critical { border: 1px solid #DC2626; color: #DC2626; } .ds-risk-critical .ds-risk-dot { background: #DC2626; }

components.name: Risk Badge Medium
components.description: Signals medium risk. Elevated attention, not immediate action.
components.css: .ds-risk-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border-radius: 2px; white-space: nowrap; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-risk-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-risk-score { opacity: 0.8; margin-left: 2px; } .ds-risk-medium { border: 1px solid #D97706; color: #D97706; } .ds-risk-medium .ds-risk-dot { background: #D97706; }

components.name: Risk Badge Low
components.description: Signals low risk. Clear - no action required.
components.css: .ds-risk-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border-radius: 2px; white-space: nowrap; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-risk-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-risk-score { opacity: 0.8; margin-left: 2px; } .ds-risk-low { border: 1px solid #16A34A; color: #16A34A; } .ds-risk-low .ds-risk-dot { background: #16A34A; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Dashboard stat card. Label top, large numeric value, optional delta and sub-label.
components.html:
ALERTS TODAY

7

+3 from yesterday
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #161B22; border: 1px solid #30363D; border-radius: 4px; padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-stat-label { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 11px; color: #8B949E; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-value { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-sub { font-size: 11px; color: #8B949E; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Live Indicator
components.description: Pulsing green dot confirming the system is actively monitoring. Appears in sidebar and live feed header.
components.css: .ds-live-indicator { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; } .ds-live-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #16A34A; display: inline-block; flex-shrink: 0; animation: ds-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-live-label { font-size: 10px; color: #16A34A; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-weight: 600; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.2; } }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Dashboard section header. The visual grammar that separates data from metadata. Always uppercase, always tracked.
components.css: .ds-section-label { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; color: #8B949E; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-weight: 600; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input. Sits visually below the card surface it lives in.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0D1117; border: 1px solid #30363D; border-radius: 4px; color: #F0F6FC; font-size: 12px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; padding: 10px 12px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none; resize: vertical; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8B949E; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4D5562; }

narrative.overview:
SentinelIQ's visual system is built around a single scene: a 24/7 security command centre running under controlled light. Every analyst knows exactly where to look. Every indicator has a single meaning. Nothing decorates; everything informs. The surface is calm because the system is always watching, and it interrupts that calm - precisely, surgically - only when threat demands it.

The system uses four tonal dark layers to convey depth without shadows. Color appears exactly three times: red for threat, amber for watch, green for clear. These are not accent colours. They are the data. Their rarity is what makes them legible - on a screen full of near-black surfaces, a single red badge stops the eye immediately.

Typography is Geist throughout: a system sans with optical engineering built in. Display weights at 800 create authority without decoration. Section labels run small, uppercase, tracked wide - the visual grammar of a data readout, not a marketing page.
keyCharacteristics: Four tonal dark layers as the entire depth vocabulary
Red, amber, green as semantic signals - never decorative
Sharp corners (2-4px radius) everywhere except avatars
Uppercase tracked labels as the visual grammar for data headers
Live pulse indicators as the only ambient motion
Maximum information density at the data level; no cosmetic padding

rules.name: The One Interruption Rule
rules.body: Threat Red appears on less than 10% of any given screen during normal operating conditions. Its rarity is the signal. Never use red for decoration, emphasis, or branding on product surfaces.

rules.name: The Semantic Lock Rule
rules.body: Red means critical/high. Amber means medium. Green means low or live. These assignments are immutable. No other UI purpose may borrow these colors.

rules.name: The Stat Weight Rule
rules.body: Numeric data values use weight 700-800 at 28-42px with letter-spacing -0.02 to -0.03em. The number is the most important thing on that surface.

rules.name: The Label Doctrine
rules.body: All section-level headers inside the dashboard use the Label style: small, uppercase, tracked. Never sentence case. The visual distinction between a label and a value is non-negotiable.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Data surfaces are flat at rest. Surface Two (#1C2128) is the hover state - it communicates interactivity through tonal shift, not shadow. If you're adding a shadow to a card or row, you're adding it to the wrong thing.

rules.name: The Dot Requirement
rules.body: The 6px filled circle before a risk badge label is non-negotiable. Color alone does not meet WCAG AA. The dot provides a redundant non-color signal. Never remove it.

dos: Do use the four tonal dark surfaces as the entire depth vocabulary.
Do pair every risk color with a text label and the filled dot in RiskBadge.
Do use uppercase tracked labels (10-11px, weight 600, letter-spacing 0.06-0.08em) for all section headers inside the dashboard.
Do apply transition: background 0.15s on interactive rows and nav items.
Do use easeOut curves for all entry animations. Never bounce, elastic, or spring.
Do stagger child entry animations at 0.13s intervals on landing sections.
Do reserve the pulsing live indicator (Clear Green, opacity loop) for components that represent real-time system state.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS dashboard patterns: blue gradients, rounded pill badges, hero metric cards with gradient accents, identical icon-heading-text card grids.
Don't use red (#DC2626) for decoration, hover states, emphasis, or any purpose other than critical/high risk and primary CTAs.
Don't add shadows to cards, table rows, or any data surface.
Don't use glassmorphism as decoration - the landing nav blur is the only acceptable instance.
Don't use border-radius greater than 4px on any card, button, or data container.
Don't add padding to screens to make them look clean - whitespace is earned at the data level.
Don't animate CSS layout properties (width, height, margin, padding). Animate opacity and transform only.
Don't build modals as a first-choice pattern - use fixed sidebar drawers or inline disclosure first.
Don't use consumer fintech visual language: friendly rounded corners, warm background tints, onboarding illustrations, playful copy.
Don't use cyberpunk aesthetics: neon green terminals, matrix-style motion, high-chroma color schemes.
